text: The sem token economy is inflationary at equilibrium, and the authors argue this is a feature: inflation improves security and discourages rent seeking by penalizing holders who do not use their tokens to evaluate posts.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Secure Proof of Stake Protocol (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3125827
abstract: The conclusion is that the economy is inflationary at equilibrium, which improves its security and discourages rent-seeking.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: fees paid in at a constant or linearly growing rate
new tokens minted with every fee and never destroyed
